title: the two player respawn count says ascending in n, not dropping in
why: His lore (memory pillagers-lore-ascend.md, 2026-08-29): YOU DO NOT DROP. YOU ASCEND. Every player-facing line that says drop in is wrong. The arcade respawn count in the top lane said DROPPING IN n. It says ascending in n now, lower case like all text since 2026-10-18. The count itself, its timing and its place are unchanged.
now: The respawn count on the demo HUD reads ascending in 3, 2, 1 (it said dropping in).
